current_interpretation: Independent large syntheses support recurrent costs of antagonist exposure, but effect magnitude is strongly heterogeneous
Antagonist exposure can suppress legitimate visitation, but a floral defence barrier need not itself impose a pollinator cost in every system
Mutualists and antagonists can track the same floral signal across volatile and visual modalities
Consumer identity/dependency repeatedly changes response to the same floral phenotype or barrier
Dose/expression thresholds remain a source-level rather than cross-meta-analysis Pattern so far
Exposure/reward/assay context can open or close measured effects
Where/how antagonists attack changes which defence or damage pathway is expressed
Effect state changes across visitation, exploitation, damage, and reproductive outcome scales
Pattern conditionality is not restricted to one floral modality or outcome class
Pollinator identity/guild changes the strength of signal-mediated effects
Expanded Pattern evidence still does not substitute for direct attraction x defence estimation
Additional Pattern modules do not identify kappa and must not be used to set it to zero
